profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer | Web | Mobile | VR
profile.summary: Meticulous, well rounded full stack software engineer dedicated to continuous improvement. Experienced software developer and educator. Skilled in Teaching, C#, JavaScript, Data Analysis, and Research. Highly interested in working in a collaborative environment at the intersection of Virtual Reality, science, and education.

positions.title: Independent VR Research
positions.description:
Following my acceptance into Oculus Launch Pad in 2019, I began a period of independent VR research, exploring tools for creating meaningful immersive experiences. I've spent the majority of this time advancing my skill with Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender, and GLSL shader creation. At present, I am developing additional VR projects:

‣ Geodra (Unreal Engine) - an intense Space Pirate Trainer-esque asteroid shooter/gem collector, envisioned to teach game development students to create VR games using Unreal and Oculus Quest, now set for upcoming release on Oculus App Lab (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xNDPvKx1fyg)
‣ Goblin Flower Delivery Service (Unity with XR Toolkit) - a wholesome experience to build flower/mushroom arrangements and deliver them to goblins, created in collaboration with two friends for the Oculus Start Game Jam (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sx8FtsRTZEY)
‣ Air Hockey (Unity with XR Toolkit, Normcore) - a basic multiplayer air hockey game
‣ Taroternia (Unity) - a tarot inspired VR journey of self discovery (Oculus Launch Pad submission)
‣ Various shader-based psychedelic and meditative environments (Unreal Engine)

Other studies include GLSL shaders (primarily https://thebookofshaders.com/), Three.js (example project https://veg.dev), and deepening my understanding of linear algebra

positions.title: Oculus Launch Pad 2019
positions.description: In 2019, I was selected to participate in the 2019 Oculus Launch Pad class with about 100 other up and coming VR industry professionals and independent developers. Using knowledge gained through this program, I've designed and develop several unique VR experiences.

positions.title: Curriculum and Instruction Manager
positions.description:
‣ Developed and assessed K-12 CS curricula for creating and/or programmatically controlling mobile apps, robots, drones, Arduino IoT devices, video games, and web sites/apps, encouraging underrepresented youth in Memphis to explore careers and education in technology
‣ Managed recruitment, scheduling, and training of three full time instructor reports, several part time instructors, and dozens of part time teaching assistants as well as technical staff for community engagement events
‣ Performed technical assessments, consultations, and course alignment with area schools

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
‣ Taught computer science topics ranging from introductory mobile app development to AP CS Principles to students in grades 3-12
‣ Prepared lessons and adapted curricula to diverse students, differing class lengths, and a variety of learning environments
‣ Led training sessions for teachers interested in obtaining a computer science teaching endorsement

positions.title: Divisional Mobility Lead
positions.description:
Mobility Lead for the Cellulose and Containerboard division at Georgia-Pacific
‣ Cross-platform enterprise mobile app development (Ionic, Xamarin, NativeScript) using OAuth with AWS and Azure integrations
‣ Full-stack web development (Angular 1, 2+; Web API (C#); Microsoft SQL Server)
‣ Demand management for ten facilities within the division
‣ Architecture alignment and training for division application developers

Software Developer for Brunswick Cellulose
‣ Full-stack web, desktop, and mobile development (JS, jQuery, Angular 1, Web API (C#), Entity Framework, Microsoft SQL Server, Ionic)

volunteerExperiences.description:
I volunteered for a weekend hackathon working with a group of three kids and another coach to develop an app showcasing a Memphis attraction. Our kids chose Graceland and created a game where you play Elvis dodging cameras, microphones, and other objects on your way to Graceland. If hit by one of these objects, the player is exposed as a lowly Elvis impersonator. Upon winning, the player is presented with randomly generated facts about Elvis and Graceland.

The kids overcame some difficult challenges (losing their code Sunday morning, being down one team member for the second day) to create an artistic and functional app meeting all of the challenge requirements.

publications.title: Chromatogram Handler: A unique computer program that efficiently processes data generated in liquid chromatographic investigations of organic ligand adsorption on mineral surfaces
